title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 戏曲是一种中国传统的艺术形式，可以追溯到唐朝。中国戏曲吸引观众的一大特色是其独具风格的脸谱 (facial painting)。脸谱代表不同角色的性格和命运。观众通过观察脸谱能够更好地理解这些角色的故事。欣赏戏曲是中国人特别是老年人的一大乐趣。为了吸引更多的年轻观众，传统戏曲正在不断地发展和创新。如今，越来越多的外国观众也喜欢中国戏曲。
reference: Chinese opera is a traditional Chinese art form, which dates back to the Tang Dynasty. A major feature of Chinese opera that attracts audiences is its uniquely styled facial painting. Facial paintings represent the personalities and destinies of different characters. By observing the facial paintings, the audience can better understand the stories of these characters. Appreciating Chinese opera is a major pleasure for Chinese people, especially the elderly. To attract more young audiences, traditional Chinese opera is constantly developing and innovating. Nowadays, more and more foreign audiences also enjoy Chinese opera.
